title: Details step gets wider than a 360 px screen after adding a photo and text
what_happens: After adding a photo and about 130 characters on step 4, the form card and the Review card are 370 px wide on a 360 px screen. Their right edge is cut off and the page scrolls sideways. Measured: innerWidth 370, scrollWidth 370; elements right of 361 px: nav, FORM.card, ASIDE.card. Before the photo and text it was 361/361.
what_should_happen: Nothing is wider than the screen at 360 px.
repro: Start the server, then run tests/qa/pass4/journey-officer_citizen.8.mjs (saves state) then journey-officer_citizen.9.mjs with with-lock.mjs browser 3; it prints WIDE and vw.
root_cause_guess: unknown; likely a grid child without min-width 0 holding the photo row or the long text (src/app/citizen/file-complaint/page.tsx)

title: Officer search cannot find a complaint by its complaint number
what_happens: Typing 2026-993UJN in the officer Search only offers 'Ask District IQ'. No complaint result.
what_should_happen: A number the citizen quotes should find the case, or the box should say what it searches.

title: A complaint filed by a citizen does not appear in the department officer's queue
what_happens: Citizen filed 2026-993UJN (Garbage, Overflowing of Garbage Bin, Ward 58 Royapuram, routed to Solid Waste Management); the track page says 'Complaint Filed' and the next step is 'Department officer reviews it'. A few minutes later the SWM officer still sees 38 waiting; the case is not in To approve, not in See all, and /api/officer/grievances has no row with 993UJN or 'Gandhi Nagar 2nd'; ?q=993UJN returns 0 rows.
what_should_happen: The case shows up in the officer's To approve list, or the app tells the citizen it will appear after the next update.
repro: tests/qa/pass4/journey-officer_citizen.12.mjs (file the complaint), then journey-officer_citizen.14.mjs and .16.mjs (look for it as the officer)
root_cause_guess: the officer queue is built from derived INC- incident rows (src/lib/officer/data.ts) that the pipeline refreshes, so a live complaint may wait for a refresh; could be by design, but nothing tells either person
skeptic_why: Fresh server on port 3195 (tests/qa/pass4/skeptic-oc3.mjs): citizenA filed via POST /api/complaints, got code 2026-525LJO, routed to Solid Waste Management. The SWM officer queue (/api/officer/grievances, default tab and tab=all, per=100) had no row with the new title tag or code, and q=<tag> or q=<code> returned 0 rows (68 bytes). Code agrees: src/lib/officer/data.ts header says the queue only reads pipeline-loaded district_intel and the complaints route never writes to it. Severity P1 kept: it is the pipeline design, but the citizen track page promises an officer review and nothing says there is a delay. Note: a ward of 58 was sent and the reply said 52; not checked further.

title: Closing a case leaves a browser console error (HTTP 428) before the password step
what_happens: Pressing Close as done sends the report first; the server answers 428, the browser logs 'Failed to load resource ... 428', then the Confirm it's you box appears and the second request succeeds.
what_should_happen: The password step is expected, so it should not leave a console error.

title: A High case says 'Not severe' in the close box
what_happens: The close box shows a High badge and, beside the button, 'Not severe: your department verifies and closes it.'
what_should_happen: Wording that does not contradict the badge, for example 'Your department closes this one; only Severe goes to the Collector.'
